heroSubheading: We sell, service and advise on the equipment that keeps Ferrymead running.
aboutHtml:
Bill and Shelley Caines opened STIHL SHOP Ferrymead in August 2023. They brought years of experience running successful outdoor power equipment shops on the West Coast, and decided to make their mark in their Christchurch hometown.

We focus on expert sales, servicing and advice on the equipment that keeps people's properties and businesses running. We stock a full range of STIHL tools and accessories, plus Masport, Cub Cadet, Rover, Honda, Hansa, Silky and Lawnmaster. Whether it's a tune up, repairs, replacement parts or finding the right tool for the job, we're here to help. Shop in store, order online for home delivery, or use click and collect when it suits you.

Come in and meet the team in Ferrymead. We know the equipment, we know your neighbourhood, and we'll give you the straight advice you need.
